Market today: Mixed signals for tech. One strategist calls for buying the dip after a tech selloff, but another warns the S&P 500 faces hurdles before a significant move higher. This suggests a cautious environment for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down 54.55% and flagged SELL. SPAL, a brand-new leveraged ETF, is down 41.75% and below its stop. SMH and QQQI are also flagged TRIM and showing losses. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and their stops. Monitor overall tech sector sentiment for signs of a sustained rebound or further weakness.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and stop adherence, especially with your leveraged and underperforming positions.
plays: SPAL: Your stop at 21.38 has been breached (price 14.65). Consider exiting or significantly reducing this leveraged position to manage risk.
SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down 54.55% and flagged SELL. Re-evaluate position size and risk; the default stop of 200 is far from current price 115.67.
SMH / QQQI: Both are flagged TRIM. Watch their stops closely (SMH at 540, QQQI at 52) and be ready to act if they approach those levels.
